_comentario: Elenco reutilizable. voz = voz de Kokoro; vel = velocidad (1.0 normal). saludos/errores/ocupado se generan una sola vez y los usan TODAS las misiones donde aparezca el personaje. cara_base = emoji sin manos para la cabeza; ropa/accesorio = guia para los SVG.

bryan.estilo: Neutral y claro. Sus 3 opciones de audio siempre usan esta voz.

sara.estilo: Calida y burlona. Frases cortas y directas.
errores: Bryan? Are you OK?
What? That's a strange thing to say.
Ha ha! Are you thinking out loud?
Sorry, I don't understand you.
Bryan, listen to me, please.

saludos: Hey, hey! Welcome to my party!
errores: What? I can't hear you!
The music is too loud, Bryan!
Sorry, what did you say?
Are you talking to me?
Ha ha! I don't understand, my friend!
ocupado: Try the cake! It is very good!

emma.estilo: Britanica, educada y formal. 'Excuse me', 'I'm afraid'.
saludos: Good evening, Bryan. Nice party, isn't it?
errores: Sorry? I don't understand.
I'm afraid I don't understand you.
Excuse me? Is that a question for me?
Sorry, are you talking to me?
I'm sorry, could you say that again?
ocupado: Excuse me, I must go now.

max.estilo: El DJ. Ocupado, rapido, respuestas muy cortas.
errores: What? Say it again!
I can't hear you. Music, man!
Sorry. I'm busy. Try again.
That is not for me.
Are you OK? What are you saying?

lily.estilo: Timida y suave. Duda, pausas con '...'.
errores: Um... sorry? I don't understand.
Oh... are you talking to me?
I'm sorry... what?
Um... can you say it again?
I think... that's not right.

george.estilo: Tio mayor, lento y olvidadizo. Bromea sobre su edad.
saludos: Well, well... Bryan! How are you, my boy?
errores: What? Speak more slowly, please.
I'm old, my boy. Say it again.
Are you talking to me, or to the wall?
Oh, I don't understand young people.
What did you say? I can't hear.
ocupado: Where is my glass? I had a glass here.
Young people! Always in a hurry.

bella.estilo: Emocionada y habladora. Habla rapido, mucha exclamacion.
saludos: Oh wow, Bryan! Hi! Isn't this party great?
errores: Wait, what? I didn't get that!
Oh no, I don't understand!
Ha ha, you are so funny, Bryan!
What? Say that again, please!
Are you OK? That is a strange question!
ocupado: Come on, dance with me later!

rosa.estilo: Taxista cansada y seca. No tiene paciencia.
errores: What? I don't understand.
Are you talking to me?
I don't have time for this.
That is not a question for a driver.
Speak slowly, please.

frank.estilo: Taxista calmado y amable, voz grave. Conversa.
saludos: Good evening! Do you need a taxi?
errores: Sorry, my friend. What did you say?
I don't understand. Say it again.
Are you OK? Is that for me?
Ha ha! No, no. Try again.
Oh... I'm a taxi driver, not a doctor.
Bryan, what are you saying?
I don't understand. Are you OK?
Bryan! Answer my question, please.
